subject.title: Chula Vista Elementary School District Board, Seat 5

text: Why do we send our children to school?

To learn to read, write, and do math. Those are the fundamental building blocks for success in school and in life. Every child should have the opportunity to learn in a safe, supportive school and receive a quality education. That is what we all want for our children.

Helping children succeed is why I serve as your Trustee, and it will continue to be my highest priority. As a retired administrator with the County of San Diego Health & Human Services Agency, and through years of volunteer service supporting families in our community, including families affected by domestic violence, I have seen firsthand that every child’s circumstances are different. Those experiences have shown me how important it is for families, school employees, and the community to work together.

Parents are a child’s first and most important teacher. They deserve honest communication, meaningful involvement, and to be welcomed as partners in their child’s education. Our employees make a difference in the lives of our children every day and deserve the training, resources, and systems they need to do their best work. That is why I requested an independent review of our Human Resources and Business Services operations—to identify where we could improve our processes and strengthen the systems that support their work. When we support one another, children have the best opportunity to succeed.

Our district has much to celebrate, and we should be proud of the many students who are thriving. At the same time, we cannot be satisfied while nearly half of our students are still not meeting California’s grade-level standards in English Language Arts, and more than half are still not meeting grade-level standards in mathematics. Behind every percentage is a child, a family, and a future. For some children, education is what changes the course of their lives.
That is why every year matters. Every child matters. Every opportunity matters.
Our children only get one chance at an elementary education. We owe it to them to make each one of those years count.
It is an honor to serve our community on the Chula Vista Elementary School Board. I hope to earn your vote for reelection. To learn more, or get in touch, please visit www.DeliaForSchoolBoard.com

text: My name is Dr. Tom Glover, and I am running for Seat No. 5 on the Chula Vista Elementary School District Governing Board.

I have spent my career as an educator within this community, serving as a Bilingual teacher, Director of Activities (ASB), Assistant Principal and Principal – Having served as a school Principal here in CVESD and at a high school in the Sweetwater District.

During my over 32 years of service. I have taught English Learners, Students learning to speak Spanish, Social Studies and support classes; I have hired teachers and other educators in all the roles within our system, developed school schedules and site plans, managed school and district departments and budgets, Served in Executive level leadership positions, but most importantly I have and worked directly with thousands of students and families in classrooms just like the ones our children attend today. As a product of CVESD and retired educator- my life has been dedicated to serving our children, their parents, and our community.

I decided to run because I believe our schools must be more than buildings with safety fences around them. They should be genuine safe places for learning, where students, parents, educators, and the community interact in ways that build trust and support every child’s growth. I know what it takes to create that environment, and I want to bring that experience to the board level.

I also believe academic, social, and personal growth goals are achievable for each student in school. Guiding a child toward success takes many hands working together, and as a board member I would push for the resources, staff support, and family partnerships that make that possible in every classroom, across CVESD.

Finally, I take seriously the board’s role as financial steward. Parents send us their children and their trust; taxpayers send us their hard-earned dollars. I will review budgets and proposals closely, ask direct questions before major decisions, and work to ensure every dollar is used in service of student learning and family opportunity.

As a board member, I will perform my role in a positive and professional manner our families deserve. I will listen to families and staff with different perspectives and explain the reasoning behind board decisions clearly to this community I have served for almost four decades.
I ask for your support on November 3.

text: I am an educator with over 25 years of experience, parent of two children attending the Chula Vista Elementary School District, and community advocate committed to protecting and strengthening public education. I believe every student deserves an exceptional education and every family deserves to feel supported throughout their educational journey.

I earned a Bachelor of Arts in Liberal Studies with an emphasis in Elementary Education and a minor in History, followed by a Master’s degree in Education with a specialization in Counseling and Guidance and a Counseling Credential.

For more than 25 years, I have served students, families, and educators in a variety of educational roles, including teacher and educational leader. Today, I run multiple educational programs and support teachers while partnering with industry and colleges to create career pathways that prepare students for high-skill, high-wage careers. I also serve as a mentor teacher for new educators because I believe investing in teachers is one of the most important investments we can make in our public schools.

As your Chula Vista Elementary School District Trustee, I will focus on academic excellence, student and staff safety, fiscal responsibility, parent engagement, support for special education, and strengthening programs such as visual and performing arts and athletics. Every student deserves equitable access to high-quality educational opportunities regardless of background, language, or ability. My experience in education has given me the knowledge to make informed decisions that keep students at the center of every policy.

Student safety is my highest priority. I believe safety includes secure campuses as well as emotionally supportive learning environments where every child feels safe, respected, valued, and welcomed. I have successfully managed multimillion-dollar budgets and will work to ensure our district remains fiscally responsible, transparent, and focused on directing resources where they have the greatest impact on student success.

As both a parent and an educator, I understand the importance of strong partnerships between schools and families. I am committed to increasing parent involvement, improving communication, and working collaboratively with teachers, staff, families, and community organizations to expand opportunities for every child.

I am running for the Chula Vista Elementary School Board because every child deserves a high-quality public education and every educator deserves the support needed to help students succeed. It would be an honor to serve the students, families, and educators of the Chula Vista Elementary School District as your Governing Board Member.

text: For more than 35 years, I have proudly served students, families, and educators in the San Ysidro, South Bay Union, and Chula Vista Elementary School Districts as a teacher, school administrator, and volunteer.

Throughout my career, I taught in the classroom, served as a principal, and worked alongside teachers, classified staff, administrators, parents, and community partners. These experiences gave me firsthand knowledge of school operations, instructional programs, campus safety, employee support, district policies, and the everyday needs of students and families.

My wife and I have called the South Bay home for more than 30 years. We raised our three sons here, we purchased our first home in the Juarez-Lincoln and Silver Wing neighborhood, and later moved to Bonita. I was honored to coach our sons’ baseball and AYSO soccer teams for many years and to serve as President of Sweetwater Valley Little League. Today, our son and daughter-in-law proudly serve as teachers in the west side of the Chula Vista Elementary School District.
After retiring, I continued serving schools throughout Chula Vista as a substitute principal, staying connected to students, educators, and families across the district.

As a Trustee for the Chula Vista Elementary School District, I will promote safe schools, strong academic achievement, support for educators, transparent leadership, and responsible fiscal stewardship. I will bring experience, integrity, and a collaborative approach to every decision, always putting students and families first.
Vote for Tony Perez for CVESD School Board Seat 5! I would be honored to earn your vote!
